column1: # THE 2026-09-14 ROUTING BAND AGAINST THE 2026-09-16 OUTCOME, for the 139 ledger residuals.
# THE NUMBERS FIRST. BODY-READ 30 bodies, 30 still unresolved. ENTRY-MENTION 65, 0 still
# unresolved. UNTOUCHED 44, 0 still unresolved. The ledger's current unresolved set IS the
# WHAT THAT IS NOT. It is not evidence that the band predicted difficulty, and it is not the
# inverted proxy it resembles. THE TWO GROUPS WENT TO DIFFERENT AGENTS. The 109 went to
# SWE2-FRONTIER as OPUS-REQ-SWE2-FRONTIER-RESIDUAL-109 and were closed - 'each body read and
# classified', 24848e06, unresolved 139 -> 30. The 30 went to SWE2-EC7 as
# OPUS-REQ-SWE2-EC7-RESIDUAL-BODY-READ-30, which has been READY AND UNCLAIMED since
# 2026-09-14. The outcome separates the bands because the ROUTING separated them. The band's
# predictive value is UNTESTED, not refuted, and these 30 are unresolved because nobody has
# WHY THE DISTINCTION IS WORTH A TABLE. The premise the routing rested on - 'these are the
# cheapest bodies on a hard L1 gate: if the reading already exists, the gap is classification
# rather than research' - was untested WHEN THIS FILE WAS WRITTEN, and the paragraph that stood
# here then told the reader to plan the remaining 30 around body reading because harvesting
# citations 'has not been tried'. CORRECTED THE SAME DAY (OPUS): IT HAD BEEN TRIED AND IT WORKED.
# residual-30-GN161-stage1.tsv (OPUS, 2026-09-15, fb75d534) validated all 30 FROM EXISTING PROSE
# and proposed 30 distinct domains; check_residual_depth bands all 30 DESCRIBED, CONTESTED 0,
# NEEDS-THE-BODY-READ 0. What remains is application and independent re-certification, not
# reading. The routing observation above still stands; the prescription drawn from it did not.
# CONTROL: all 139 are still present in the certified GN161 function list (batch_R109/post.fas2,
# 38,161 functions, unresolved 30, overlap 0), so 'no longer unresolved' means CLASSIFIED and
# not REMOVED. A body that left the census would leave the unresolved set too and would be
# indistinguishable from a classification if only the count were read.
# The two descriptive columns are kept because they were the band's inputs, NOT because they

# against 12 in 65 for ENTRY-MENTION, with median body 937 B against 759 B. Too weak to carry
